name: RT Core Inversion — Shadow Cast & Ray Scatter
concept: RT cores are hardware BVH traversal engines. Games use them to trace light. We INVERT them — they trace GAIA's perception rays through the mesh instead.

shadow_cast.game_purpose: Cast shadows from light sources onto geometry
shadow_cast.gaia_purpose: Cast INFLUENCE shadows — which gates occlude which data paths. A gate going down casts a 'shadow' on the mesh topology. RT cores compute the shadow map in real-time.
shadow_cast.implementation: Vulkan RT pipeline — BVH of gate positions, ray cast from each gate, shadow = reachability

ray_scatter.game_purpose: Global illumination — light bouncing off surfaces
ray_scatter.gaia_purpose: DATA scatter — how information propagates through the mesh. Each 'bounce' is a hop. RT cores trace the scatter pattern to find optimal data routes.
ray_scatter.implementation: OptiX path tracing — mesh topology as scene, data packets as photons, gates as surfaces with BRDF (bandwidth reflectance)

ray_generation.game_purpose: Camera shoots rays into the scene
ray_generation.gaia_purpose: SENSOR rays — each gate shoots perception rays. What can northGate 'see'? What's in ironGate's shadow? RT cores generate the perceptual field.
ray_generation.implementation: Vulkan ray gen shader — one ray per gate-to-gate pair, result = latency + bandwidth + reachability

closest_hit.gaia_purpose: Find NEAREST GATE for any given task. Need Ollama? RT traces to find lowest-latency model host. Need storage? Traces to nearest disk.
closest_hit.implementation: BVH of all services across mesh — RT intersection = service discovery

any_hit.gaia_purpose: FIREWALL check — does a data path pass through any untrusted node? RT 'any hit' shader = security check on every data route.
any_hit.implementation: skunkBat intrusion detection as any-hit shader

miss.gaia_purpose: Data reaches OUTSIDE the mesh — internet egress. Miss shader = water lock protocol activation.
miss.implementation: Miss = data leaving LAN, triggers water lock review

crimson_desert.name: Crimson Desert Enhanced
crimson_desert.note: Uses RT for shadows, GI, reflections — SAME RT cores we invert
crimson_desert.stream_to: frameGate via Steam Remote Play over 10G spine

architecture.layer_1: Vulkan RT pipeline on each gate — compiles mesh topology into BVH
architecture.layer_2: Ray generation = sensor sweep — one ray per gate pair
architecture.layer_6: Miss shader = water lock (data leaving mesh)
architecture.layer_7: Games run ON TOP of this — RT cores do BOTH at once
